items.title: Saab Announces Key Partners for Gripen Canada
items.summary: Saab Announces Key Partners for Gripen Canada 2026-10-27 14:00:00 Saab plans to work with CAE, IMP and Magellan Aerospace as its principal Canadian industry partners if Gripen E is selected by the Government of Canada. items.title: Saabs resultat Kv3 2026: Positionerade för att ta vara på ökad efterfrågan
items.summary: Saabs resultat Kv3 2026: Positionerade för att ta vara på ökad efterfrågan 2026-10-23 07:30:00 Saab presenterar resultatet för januari-september 2026. - I kvartalet levererade vi hög organisk försäljningstillväxt, betydligt ökat kassaflöde och stark orderingång. Den växande efterfrågan från kunderna speglas i flera betydande kontrakt, däribland Gripen till Ukraina, GlobalEye och en order kopplad till Tysklands nya fregatter. Samtidigt fortsätter vi att investera i framtida förmågor och utöka vår produktionskapacitet. items.title: Saab receives order for new Gripen computer
items.summary: Saab receives order for new Gripen computer 2026-10-15 10:33:00 Saab has received an order from the Swedish Defence Materiel Administration (FMV) for the development of a new generation flight control computer for Gripen. The order value is SEK 1.3 billion with deliveries planned during 2030. Saab will replace the current version of Gripen's flight control computer with a future-proof solution designed to meet long-term requirements for availability, performance and security of supply. items.title: Saab: Canada takes next step towards future GlobalEye capability
items.summary: Saab: Canada takes next step towards future GlobalEye capability 2026-09-25 15:36:00 Saab has signed a non-binding term-sheet agreement with the Canadian Defence Investment Agency (DIA), establishing the scope and foundation for detailed negotiations regarding the acquisition of Saab's GlobalEye Airborne Early Warning and Control (AEW&C) solution for the Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF). The agreement marks an important milestone following Canada's announcement on 27 May 2026, identifying Saab as the preferred supplier for the nation's future AEW&C capability. items.summary: Saab: The Netherlands announces intention to procure GlobalEye 2026-09-10 08:10:00 The Netherlands has signed a Letter of Intent with Sweden for the acquisition of a Saab GlobalEye Early Warning and Control (AEW&C) aircraft. items.title: Saab receives order from FMV for further work on future concept
items.summary: Saab receives order from FMV for further work on future concept 2026-09-09 14:00:00 Saab has received an order from the Swedish Defence Material Administration (FMV) for continued concept work on future fighter system. The order value is approximately SEK 2.9 billion. The contract period is 2026-2028, with options for 2029 and 2030. The contract is to further develop and demonstrate new technologies for future fighter system. The work includes flying and ground-based demonstrators, advanced studies and the development of future system concepts for manned and unmanned systems. items.title: Saab receives order for RBS 70 NG from Finland
items.summary: Saab receives order for RBS 70 NG from Finland 2026-08-28 09:00:00 Saab has signed a contract and received an initial order from The Finnish Defence Forces Logistics Command for deliveries of the RBS 70 NG air defence solution. The order value is SEK 1.2 billion The new contract also enables Finland to place additional future orders for the RBS 70 NG as well as training, spare parts and maintenance equipment.
